facts.value: Most studies have shown that religious involvement and spirituality are associated with better health outcomes, including greater longevity, coping skills, and health-related quality of life, and less anxiety, depression, and suicide.
The influence of religion on health is largely beneficial, according to a review of related literature.
Several studies have discovered positive correlations between religious belief and practice and mental and physical health and longevity.

The role of different dimensions of spirituality/religiosity in health is complicated; findings about the relationship between spirituality/religiosity and health cannot be generalized across denominations or assumed to be uniform for men and women.
